title: Crossnacreevy Weather
text: package provides tools processing, summarising visualising daily meteorological data AFBI Crossnacreevy weather station. transforms daily weather summaries monthly summary tables range data visualisations, making easier explore seasonal patterns, monitor weather conditions examine historical meteorological trends. package designed provide consistent reproducible workflow summarising weather observations, outputs suitable reporting, exploratory data analysis research.

code: library(crossmet) ## basic example code

what: Import weather data from Excel — ImportWeather
title: Import weather data from Excel — ImportWeather
text: Imports weather data Excel workbook individual worksheets contain data separate years. worksheets required cover requested date range imported. resulting data combined, filtered requested dates, converted long format. Excel workbook expected contain following columns: `date`, `DOY`, `Temperature deg C`, `Air temp`, `Temp diff`, `Rainfall`, `Soil 15cm`, `Soil 45cm`, `Average Wind`, `RH`, `Leaf`, `Lite totals`. Worksheet names expected contain four-digit year, example `"2023"`, `"2024"`, `"2025"`.

title: Import weather data from Excel — ImportWeather
code: ImportWeather(file, start_date = "2013-01-01", end_date = Sys.Date())

title: Import weather data from Excel — ImportWeather
text: file Character string. Path Excel workbook containing weather data. start_date Start date period import. Either `Date` object character string can converted date using `.Date()`, e.g. `"2023-01-01"`. end_date End date period import. Either `Date` object character string can converted date using `.Date()`, e.g. `"2025-12-31"`.

title: Import weather data from Excel — ImportWeather
text: tibble long format four columns: date Observation date. DOY Day year. variable Weather variable measured. value Observed value.

title: Import weather data from Excel — ImportWeather
text: worksheets corresponding years `start_date` `end_date` read. example, request `"2023-06-01"` `"2025-04-30"` attempt read 2023, 2024 2025 worksheets. worksheets combined, observations outside requested date range removed.

title: Save weather plots — SaveWeatherPlots
text: Creates selected weather plots saves specified directory.

title: Save weather plots — SaveWeatherPlots
code: SaveWeatherPlots(   data,   plots = c("temperature", "air_temperature", "temperature_difference", "rainfall",     "soil_temperature", "wind_speed", "relative_humidity", "leaf_wetness",     "solar_radiation"),   monthly_grids = TRUE,   path = getwd(),   width = 8,   height = 5,   dpi = 300,   device = "png" )

title: Save weather plots — SaveWeatherPlots
text: data data frame containing weather data long format. data must contain columns `Date`, `DOY`, `variable`, `value`. plots Character vector specifying plots create. Available options `"temperature"`, `"air_temperature"`, `"temperature_difference"`, `"rainfall"`, `"soil_temperature"`, `"wind_speed"`, `"relative_humidity"`, `"leaf_wetness"`, `"solar_rad"`. path Character string giving directory save plots. directory created exist. width Width saved plot inches. Default 8. height Height saved plot inches. Default 5. dpi Resolution saved images dots per inch. Default 300. device Character string specifying output image format. Default `"png"`.

title: Save weather plots — SaveWeatherPlots
text: Invisibly returns character vector containing paths   files created.
